description: Compute the exact SPF lookup cost across a supplied include tree. The budget of ten resolving mechanisms is shared across the whole evaluation rather than per record, which is why a record with three includes can cost fourteen lookups and no single record looks wrong. Reports the total against the limit, the headroom left, a cycle in the include chain, and every include whose record was not supplied so the total is a floor. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

domain.description: The domain the evaluation starts from. A record for it must be supplied. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

records.description: The record for each domain in the tree, one per domain. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

example.record: v=spf1 a mx include:_spf.shared.test include:_spf.regional.test ip4:203.0.113.0/24 ~all

domain.description: The domain this record is published at. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

record.description: Its SPF record. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

name: spf_include_budget_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

domains.description: Per domain: its own lookups and its record, ordered by cost, which is where the budget actually goes.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

unresolved_includes.description: Includes whose records were not supplied, so the total is a floor.

within_budget.description: True only when the whole tree was supplied and the total stayed clear of the limit.

title: SPF Include Budget Audit
